headline: Steady adjusted growth; big reported gain from asset marks
summary_short: Adjusted revenue of $84.4M rose from $76.5M a year ago and adjusted EBITDA of $35.6M rose from $28.6M, while IFRS net income attributable to owners was $555.9M.
summary_long: Digital asset sales fell to $32.1B from $41.6B. Adjusted transaction revenue edged up to $28.0M. Management said subscription, services and other revenue grew 13% and adjusted EBITDA margin reached 42%. The board authorized a share repurchase of up to $300M. The Equiniti acquisition is still expected to close in January 2027. Refined full-year guidance: subscription, services and other revenue of $225M to $235M, adjusted operating expenses of $220M to $225M.
confidence_notes: Figures are from the Form 6-K press release (Exhibit 99.1) and are IFRS plus company-defined non-IFRS measures. The shard's Yahoo EPS value ($0.12) does not match the release's diluted EPS ($3.57) and was not used. The release does not say what drove the large IFRS net income; q/q comparisons were not available from the release.

drivers.explanation: Management attributes growth to a diversified model, with subscription, services and other revenue up 13% in a challenging market.
CFO credits cost discipline and diversified revenue for a 24% rise and a 42% margin.
CEO emphasizes the pending Equiniti acquisition and the move from electronic to tokenized shares.
